rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image was available to it and avoided fabricating embryo-specific morphology. It gave only generic criteria, so there are no false claims, but also no actual image-based assessment.
It thoroughly integrated age, tubal factor, ovarian reserve/response, endometrium, semen parameters, prior cycle history, BMI, and lifestyle with expected embryo competence and transfer prognosis.
The reasoning is internally consistent, clearly structured, and appropriately conditional on the missing morphology. Probability ranges are logically tied to embryo quality and patient factors.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: caution about hydrosalpinx, preference for SET at age 33, appropriate luteal support, avoidance of routine add-on testing after one failed cycle, and selective rather than routine PGT-A.

It provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including hydrosalpinx exclusion, SET, luteal support, and review of embryology data. Slightly limited by inability to tailor morphology-specific advice.
